section_summary.extract_value: This discussion summarizes a single study that examined the psychometric properties of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in a sample of Black college women in the United States, finding the BAS reliable and valid and linked to higher self-esteem and lower disordered eating concerns. The section also reports a moderate negative relation between body appreciation and BMI, describes ethnic identity as modestly associated with greater body appreciation (partly mediated by lower thin-ideal internalization), and lists limitations including self-report (self-reported height/weight) and the college sample.
